topology.description: Reduced forward-wave circuit: posterior touch receptor initiates A27h-like premotor activity; each premotor excites its segment motor pool; shortening-sensitive proprioception excites the next anterior premotor pool.
limitations: Not a complete brain or VNC connectome.
The reduced proprioceptor-to-next-premotor edge is a circuit-level approximation, not a claimed identified monosynaptic connection.
One bilateral longitudinal motor pool represents many neurons and muscles per segment.

parameter_provenance.objective: Produce one stable posterior-to-anterior neural and contraction wave in the existing reference body while preserving the published L1 segment order and remaining inside continuous biophysical interfaces.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: All numeric neural, sensory, activation, adaptation, and contact parameters require fitting against held-out L1 recordings; none is a measured L1 constant.

sources.used_for: A27h forward-wave premotor role and A27h-to-motor connectivity
